***

## *Hydra circumcincta* distribution

 Back to all species [distribution](dist.qmd)

 
```{r}
#| echo: false
# 1. Load libraries and copy data
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(leaflet)

hydra_sw <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dem04747/Data2/main/strains_nov26.csv")

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
# Filter empty cells for species, lat2, and long2
# Select relevant columns
hydra_redux <- hydra_sw |>
  select(local_name,strain,species,lat2,long2,col_locality,col_name,photo_url)|>
  filter(species == "circumcincta") |>
  filter(!is.na(species) & species != "" & str_trim(species) != "") |>
  filter(
    !is.na(lat2) & lat2 != "" & str_trim(lat2) != "",
    !is.na(long2) & long2 != "" & str_trim(long2) != ""
  )
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
# Ensure your coordinates are numeric
hydra_clean <- hydra_redux |> 
  mutate(
    lat2 = parse_number(as.character(lat2)),
    long2 = parse_number(as.character(long2))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(lat2), !is.na(long2))
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| 
library(RColorBrewer)
library(leaflet)

# 1. Define your specific species and their exact colors
species_colors <- c(
  "canadensis"     = "gold",
  "circumcincta"   = "purple",
  "hymanae"        = "#2bdff6",
  "lirosoma"       = "#f07cb8",
  "oligactis"      = "darkorange",
  "oxycnida"       = "#e7298a",
  "unknown"        = "#4393c3",
  "utahensis"      = "blue",
  "viridissima"    = "#08a90e",
  "vulgaris"       = "#342626"
)

# 2. Create the color factor mapping using the named vector
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = species_colors,
  domain = names(species_colors) # or hydra_clean$species
)

# 3. Create map
leaflet(hydra_clean) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~long2, lat = ~lat2,
    color = ~pal(species),
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Species:</b> H. ", species, "<br>",
      "<b>Strain:</b> ", strain, "<br>",
      "<b>Locality:</b> ", col_locality, "<br>",
      "<b>Collector:</b> ", col_name, "<br>",
      "<b>Google Maps:</b> <a href='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=", lat2, ",", long2, "' target='_blank'>Open in Google Maps</a><br>",
      
      # Thumbnail image with JavaScript function call
      "<img src='", photo_url, "' style='width:100%; max-width:250px; height:auto; border-radius:4px; margin-top:5px; cursor:pointer;' onclick='showMapModal(\"", photo_url, "\", this)'>"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright", 
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~species, 
    title = "Species", 
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      // Create a global or attached function to handle the centered floating image
      window.showMapModal = function(url, imgElement) {
        // Find the map container element
        var mapContainer = el;
        
        // Check if a modal already exists inside this map, if so remove it
        var existingModal = mapContainer.querySelector('.map-photo-modal');
        if (existingModal) {
          existingModal.remove();
        }
        
        // Create the overlay container
        var modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.className = 'map-photo-modal';
        modal.style.position = 'absolute';
        modal.style.top = '0';
        modal.style.left = '0';
        modal.style.width = '100%';
        modal.style.height = '100%';
        modal.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)';
        modal.style.zIndex = '10000';
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        modal.style.justifyContent = 'center';
        modal.style.alignItems = 'center';
        modal.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        
        // Create the enlarged image
        var bigImg = document.createElement('img');
        bigImg.src = url;
        bigImg.style.maxWidth = '95%';
        bigImg.style.maxHeight = '95%';
        bigImg.style.borderRadius = '8px';
        bigImg.style.boxShadow = '0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
        bigImg.style.objectFit = 'contain';
        
        modal.appendChild(bigImg);
        
        // Click anywhere on the overlay to close it
        modal.onclick = function() {
          modal.remove();
        };
        
        mapContainer.appendChild(modal);
      };
      
      // Legend circle styling fixes
      var d = document.querySelectorAll('.info.legend i');
      for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
        d[i].style.borderRadius = '50%';
        d[i].style.width = '12px';
        d[i].style.height = '12px';
        d[i].style.marginTop = '3px';
      }
    }
  ")
```
